verdict.rationale: Bento supports outbound webhooks via a 'Send webhook' workflow action that fires when a trigger condition is met, letting external systems (CRM, fulfillment, support queue) be notified of events — this satisfies the core ask of subscribing to events via webhooks. However, evidence is limited to a single workflow-builder action page with no dedicated webhook subscription API, event-type catalog, signature/security verification, or retry/delivery guarantees documented. missing for 10: webhook management API docs, list of subscribable event types, payload signing/verification details, delivery retry semantics.
